title: ID0451388-DC/SI-D/AT[Y2/RN300000003010] - Chargers with dispensers offline
description:
Reported behavior:
The station has been offline since 2025-09-17. We currently have
several other chargers with dispensers that are offline.
(Y2/RN300000003010, Y2/RN300000003009) All went offline
during the same period. All with the same firmware. I suspect a CFast card defect. Maybe something went wrong with an update?
Or coincidence.
Please provide a work order so I can repair the station on-site.
